title: Embedding coefficient-estimation sample indices
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. For each frequency $S$ in the low-degree junta Fourier family, the coefficient-estimation sample indices embed injectively into the combined restricted sample indices by sending each index to its block, indexed by the rank of $S$.
